name: 读表算同比
tagline: 走查用：按格子取营业收入、由平台算同比

workflow.title: 读表算同比
workflow.summary: 从你的表里按格子取两年的营业收入，由平台算同比
workflow.method_text: List the user's data with list_my_data and read the table with read_my_table; a cell address is <dataset_id>:<sheet>!<row label>@<column label>, exactly as read_my_table shows them. Pass the task id given in the step instructions on every call. Take operating revenue (营业收入) for 2023-12-31 and 2024-12-31 as they are and put each into `raw` with its cell address. Compute the year-on-year growth with compute, input names cur (2024) and prev (2023), expression `(cur - prev) / prev`, round 4; put it into `growth` with the returned id as compute_id. Never type or compute a number yourself. In `answer` say the growth in plain words. Reply with ONE JSON object only, no markdown fences: {"answer": string, "raw": [{"item": string, "period": string, "address": string, "value": string}], "growth": [{"period": string, "compute_id": string, "value": string}], "conclusion": ""}. Leave conclusion empty. No buy or sell advice.
